notes.title: Timeline-inspired patch notes
changes: Introduced a dedicated patch notes timeline with a polished modal layout.
Added a header shortcut to quickly open the latest release highlights.
Smoothed animations and readability for update details.

notes.title: Media moments refresh
changes: Refined the media viewer transitions for a softer opening experience.
Improved accessibility labels for navigation controls and buttons.
Tweaked gradients to better match the accent palette.

notes.title: Performance & UX
changes: Optimized loading states to keep cards and previews feeling snappy.
Standardized button styles across capsules and admin screens.
Reduced layout shifts on slower connections.
